description_expanded: Immerse yourself in the serene luxury of SeaStone , your idyllic beachside sanctuary tucked away in the sought-after Gulfview Heights off picturesque Scenic Highway 30A. This pristine, newly-built white abode epitomizes coastal elegance fused with lavish comfort, setting the stage for a beach reunion like no other. With five beautifully appointed bedrooms, each a secluded haven boasting opulent ensuite baths, SeaStone welcomes you and 15 other esteemed guests to a realm of unparalleled bliss. Though the shimmering white sand beaches are mere moments away, promising endless escapades in the sand, SeaStone's enchanting backyard oasis—with its beckoning 8x15 private pool and verdant setting—invites a pause, a breath, a moment to savor paradise found at your doorstep. Plunge into the crystal-clear embrace of your private swimming pool or surrender to the soothing caress of the bubbling hot tub. This outdoor haven is framed by a spacious covered veranda, an arena of leisure featuring an outdoor kitchen, a living and dining area that embodies the spirit of the ultimate pool party. Here, culinary exploits await at the grill, cocktails mix at the wet bar, and alfresco dining unfolds at a table for eight, all against the backdrop of your favorite game on a grand wall-mounted flatscreen TV. Luxuriate on plush, white-cushioned couches or loveseats, strategically placed for optimal relaxation and poolside enjoyment. Venture inside to discover the heart of SeaStone, where the living, dining, and kitchen areas merge in a luminous, open-plan space illuminated by an entire wall of windows. A beach-inspired living room, adorned with tropical touches, invites both lively socializing and indulgent TV marathons. Dine in sophistication at a hardwood table designed for ten, seamlessly connecting to an entertainment kitchen that lures the culinary curious. White custom cabinetry and gleaming stainless steel appliances await to facilitate your gastronomic adventures. On the first floor, the primary suite offers a refuge of contemporary elegance, featuring a king-size bed, a flatscreen TV for evening leisure, and an ensuite bath that elevates relaxation with its deep soaking tub and glass-encased shower. Ascend to the second level to find four guest quarters, each a bastion of calm and luxury. Choose between king-sized sanctuaries or a bunk room outfitted with queen beds and a cozy bean bag chair—each space promises comfort and entertainment. But the allure of SeaStone extends beyond its walls. A brief drive transports you to the Gulf Place, the Santa Rosa Beach coastal village center, where the charm of Old Florida intertwines with the enchantment of the evening. Meander through landscapes dotted with Royal Palms, partake in art shows, savor outdoor concerts, and explore an array of dining and shopping delights. Prepare for an experience at SeaStone, where every moment harmonizes the joys of beachside serenity with the pinnacle of luxury living. Your dream vacation beckons, ready to forge unforgettable memories and celebrate the simple pleasures of life under the Florida sun. Welcome to SeaStone—welcome home! First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub, Powder Room, Laundry, Garage Access. Second Floor: Bonus Room with Foosball, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Bunk Room with Two Queen Bunks and Tub/Shower Combo. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool and spa (available Oct-April if needed).
